record.explanation: Chlorine and iodine-based (halogen) disinfectants become unstable and lose efficacy above 43°C (110°F) due to volatilization of chlorine and sublimation of iodine. Veterinary disinfection guidelines specify a maximum temperature of 43°C / 110°F. Option (c) shows '110º C / 43º F' with the unit labels swapped; the values correspond to 110°F / 43°C.
